table.title: [Opium Poppy Cultivation: Area and Production, 1929-1920]
table.caption_extra: [Section: Control of Opium] Untitled; introduced by 'The result of poppy cultivation for the years succeeding the enforcement of the opium control law is as follows:'. Column order as printed (1929, 1928, 1927, 1926, 1925, 1924, 1920).
table.context: Under 'Control of Opium', the text gives the area (chobu) and production (kan) of legal poppy cultivation for the years after the 1919 uniform rules limited it to medical needs.
transcriber_notes: Rows: 2 as printed. No totals printed.
Units (Chobu, Kan) printed small above the figures in each cell; moved to row labels.
Area 1920 '94': left side of first digit is broken in the scan; read as 9 (top loop and tail visible), kept as 94.
Read from crops of full/p0113.jpg (1300x300 table crop; 250% right-edge crop).
Verified: an independent blind second transcription agreed on every figure except the cells noted; totals that do not reconcile are as printed.
